description: Budget for what a cold Home load downloads and runs under the component-group loader (js/plugin.js, js/component-groups.json). Checked by tests/frontend/bootstrap/bootstrap-bundle-budget.test.mjs, which boots the real loader with the real manifest and groups file for each scenario and reads the groups it asks for before JE.initialized. Per scenario: the exact list of groups, the module count, raw bytes (sum of the module files) and gzip bytes (level 9 of the module files concatenated in run order). Scenarios: allFeaturesOn (every user-facing feature on as on the performance-review lab, every poster tag type on, JE native Home tabs for the pages, administrator), defaults (PluginConfiguration.cs stock defaults, a user with no saved settings), tagsOnly (defaults plus the nine poster tag types). Also: core's raw bytes, allFeaturesOn's share of the whole manifest's raw bytes, and a ceiling for any one group other than core, tags, seerr and settings. HOW TO UPDATE: run `node scripts/bundle-budgets.mjs` to print today's numbers. When the group list of a scenario changes on purpose, copy it into measured.scenarios. To change a limit, add a history entry (date, change, measured, limits, reason) and copy its limits into `limits`: `limits` is always the last entry's. It is a ratchet: lowering a limit needs no reason; an entry that raises any limit must say why in `reason`. Headroom is about 3% over the measured value.

history.change: lazy feature bundles (branch perf/lazy-feature-bundles): component modules load in groups, on demand
history.reason: First budget: today's measured values plus about 3% headroom; allFeaturesOn must stay at or below 45% of the manifest's raw bytes. Before the split every page downloaded and ran the single bundle, 5,078,353 raw bytes / 195 modules.

history.change: home-screen tag performance: resting flow layout with custom CSS detection, observers that let answered cards go
history.reason: Code the poster tags gained at boot since the first budget (allFeaturesOn +60,156 raw / +16,261 gzip bytes, tagsOnly +50,324 / +13,719): core/tag-layout.js +25.0 KB (the resting flow layout and the custom CSS detection that keeps a moved or layered card positioned), tags/tag-direct-play.js +9.8 KB and tags/statustags.js +7.7 KB (observers that release answered cards), tags/tag-layout-styles.js +6.1 KB, tags/tag-pipeline.js +5.6 KB, about 6 KB elsewhere. Limits for allFeaturesOn and tagsOnly are the new measured values plus about 3% headroom; every other limit is unchanged.
